description: Day 8: Episode 01 promo poster Don Galo and young Ecuaman
prompt: Movie poster for animated short film, vertical 2:3 composition. Cinematic emotional scene: old Ecuadorian fisherman Don Galo (75 years old, weathered face, white shirt, straw Toquilla hat) sitting at the edge of a small mangrove shrimp pond in Manabí Ecuador at golden hour, kind paternal expression, looking down at the water. In the water peeking up curiously is YOUNG ADOLESCENT ECUAMAN (smaller version, orange hex F39A2B segmented body, curved shrimp tail, NO cape, NO trident, just antennae with red yellow Ecuadorian tassels and a small E mark on his cefalotorax). Warm sunset light, mangroves silhouettes, Pacific Ocean horizon. Pixar Coco emotional aesthetic, deep human-creature connection, intimate familial atmosphere. Title text space at bottom

ECUAMAN floating peacefully in calm Pacific Ocean waters, serene contemplative expression, eyes half-closed in meditation, body relaxed in zen-like state. Royal blue cape hex 0046AD gently flowing in slow currents. Electric blue belt with 'ECUAMAN' text and gold E medallion. Cyan trident hex 00D9FF held loosely at his side.
